modeReason: Two top stories (the chip-maker scandal's escalation to a congressional summons and funding fallout, and the nationwide flight ground stop) each score novelty2 × magnitude3 × breadth3 = 18, far above the threshold of 8 required for industry-tagged stories, and the ground-stop story alone clears even the stricter bar on its own.
phrase: An aviation agency expanded its AI tool nationwide today, and still grounded every flight. Meanwhile, AI agents got a wallet to spend your money while you wait.
phraseAlternatives: A flight agency rolled out AI help for congested skies today. Every airport in the country stopped flying anyway, and AI agents got a wallet instead.
Today an aviation agency expanded AI traffic help nationwide. The whole country's airports stopped regardless, while an AI agent quietly got permission to spend your money.
AI traffic help went nationwide today, and every airport stopped flying anyway. Elsewhere, an AI agent got a wallet, so now it can wait for you too.

brief.concept: An aviation agency rolls its AI traffic tool out across the whole country, and the whole country's flights stop anyway; meanwhile, an AI agent calmly gets a wallet so it can shop while everyone waits.
brief.metaphor: A grounded paper airplane frozen on an empty runway beside a flashing AI control panel, while next door a small robot calmly checks out at a shop counter with its own wallet.

cast.who: a human air traffic worker standing with arms crossed beside a glowing AI control panel
a paper airplane grounded on an empty runway, wheels stuck
a departures board reading ALL FLIGHTS STOPPED
a cheerful AI robot holding a wallet, reaching into a shopping cart

brief.composition: Split single frame: left two-thirds shows an airport with a grounded paper airplane stuck on an empty runway, a departures board reading ALL FLIGHTS STOPPED behind it, and a human air traffic worker standing with arms crossed beside a glowing AI control panel. Right third, separated by a thin horizon line, shows a small cheerful AI robot holding a wallet, reaching into a shopping cart, calm and unaffected by the chaos next door.
brief.alt: On one side, a paper airplane sits grounded on an empty runway next to a departures board reading ALL FLIGHTS STOPPED, while a human worker stands beside a glowing AI control panel. On the other side, a cheerful robot holds a wallet and reaches into a shopping cart, unaffected by the chaos.
